run_stage_fixedbb: run the Metropolis-Hastings sampling loop with uniform proposal and energy-based acceptance on protein sequences
review_stage_fixedbb: review the stage_fixedbb function that performs MCMC sampling using Bernoulli acceptance and OneHotCategorical proposals
summarize_stage_fixedbb: summarize the stage_fixedbb function which mutates one position per batch and accepts based on energy loss
refactor_stage_fixedbb: refactor the stage_fixedbb function to support custom proposal distributions beyond uniform amino acid sampling
test_stage_fixedbb: test the stage_fixedbb function by verifying acceptance ratios and sequence updates across MCMC iterations
